about: Every frame of the mobile anti-aircraft gun board as its own PNG at native size, with its zoom and a caption. board.png is the sheet; the 3x copies on it are nearest-neighbour copies of the *_plan.png frames.

frames.caption: A  Half-track with a quad mount at zoom 1 (the vehicle 4 px per metre, the battery 8): a tank, the vehicle at three headings in the enemy's slate blue and once in the players' brick red, the battery
A  Half-track with a quad mount at the planning zoom 0.35 (the planes' 14 px floor: the vehicle about 1.6 px per metre)
A  Half-track with a quad mount at zoom 2, the camera's closest (the vehicle 8 px per metre)

B  Tracked hull with an open twin turret at zoom 1 (the vehicle 4 px per metre, the battery 8): a tank, the vehicle at three headings in the enemy's slate blue and once in the players' brick red, the battery
B  Tracked hull with an open twin turret at the planning zoom 0.35 (the planes' 14 px floor: the vehicle about 1.6 px per metre)
B  Tracked hull with an open twin turret at zoom 2, the camera's closest (the vehicle 8 px per metre)

C  Light carrier with a ring mount at zoom 1 (the vehicle 4 px per metre, the battery 8): a tank, the vehicle at three headings in the enemy's slate blue and once in the players' brick red, the battery
C  Light carrier with a ring mount at the planning zoom 0.35 (the planes' 14 px floor: the vehicle about 1.6 px per metre)
C  Light carrier with a ring mount at zoom 2, the camera's closest (the vehicle 8 px per metre)
A ground vehicle's shadow as the marker layer drew it before this change: its footprint offset by the layer's shadow offset for its height, which is 0 at the surface, so the shadow hides under it

The same vehicles with the marker layer's rule now (ui.json marker.cast_shadow_on, PROPOSED, on): the footprint offset by height x 0.97 m away from the sun (marker.cast_height_m: 2.0 m for the tank, 2.4 m for the gun)
